title: Filters is not implemented
body: `tg_automation.filters.filter_users(users, *, mode, custom=None)` accepts one of three modes — `active`, `inactive`, `custom` — and returns the filtered user list. `active` keeps users with `messages_sent + reactions_given >= 1`; `inactive` is its strict complement; `custom` accepts a list of comparator predicate strings on `messages_sent`, `reactions_given`, and `active_days` using operators `>=`, `>`, `<=`, `<`, `==` (e.g., `messages_sent>=5`); multiple predicates are ANDed together. `custom` mode with no predicates, unknown modes, unknown fields, and malformed predicates each raise `ValueError`. The predicate parser is exposed as a public helper `tg_automation.filters.parse_custom_predicate(expr)` and raises `ValueError` for unknown fields or malformed syntax. The CLI exposes this as the `filter-users` subcommand with `--mode <active|inactive|custom>` and repeatable `--predicate <expr>`.
acceptance_hint: 9 executable checks over the filters surface.
